text:
marta: FYI seeing a small spike in 413s hitting /v1/embeddings this morning. quick triage suggests mixed-dim requests where a single element is huge and breaks our splitter.

leo: any example requests? rough size / dims?

marta: sample from logs: dims header: [1024,512,1024], payload ~62KB, one long paragraph ~45KB. ingress preflight rejects with 413 before splitter emits smaller chunks.

ingest-bot: preflight-check: 2026-03-20T22:14:01Z route=embeddings status=413 reason=oversize payload_bytes=62412 client=tenant-88 dims=[1024,512,1024]

anya: sounds like our preflight byte cap counts the whole body. splitter expects to get the request and then emit per-dim shards, but we don't build that buffer at ingress. mismatch in semantics.

leo: options: 1) make ingress smarter and fast-chunk mixed-dim payloads, 2) return improved 413 with split advice + SDK snippet, 3) change docs to require client-side chunking when sending mixed dims.

marta: prefer quick customer UX: (2) + console CTA + telemetry to track. long term we can do (1) with a canary since it changes ingress CPU/latency profile.

sdk-team: we can add embed_chunker helper in python/js SDKs this week. will send a PR with examples and a small client-side flag to auto-split for mixed dims.

console-team: we'll add a banner on the route page when recent tenant errors > 0.5% linking to the chunking snippet and the SDK helper.

leo: also add a preflight metric `preflight.split_expected=true|false` so console can show how often we expected to split vs rejected.

marta: agreed. i'll file EMB-1301 to track 413 response body change + telemetry, and a follow-up EMB-1302 for ingress canary plan.

ingest-bot: ticket created EMB-1301 (friendly 413 + chunking hint)

anya: note: add unit tests covering mixed dims with a huge element and verify preflight->splitter race doesn't regress.

marta: thanks all. short-term rollout: update 413 message, SDK chunker, console CTA. canary for ingress chunking after telemetry shows reduced client errors.

leo: thanks — ping here when the SDK PR lands and i'll do a staging canary with tenant-88 sample data. :thumbsup:
